title: Object Residue / Use Persists After Function

source_refs.author: Material-culture and film-continuity practice
source_refs.title: Object biography, trace, and prop continuity

observed_structure: an object completes its immediate plot function
wear, placement, sound, or contamination remains
later action responds to the residue rather than resetting the object
cinematic_affordances: negative space where the object was removed
another character handles the altered state
cultural_scope: cross-cultural material principle; specific object meanings require project-local provenance
misuse_risks: continuity detail mistaken for thematic meaning
transferable_structure: an object's changed state persists after use and becomes evidence that constrains or redirects later action
non_transferable_surface: assigning universal symbolic meaning to a specific object without cultural or narrative evidence
